title: Kill cam: rewind the last seconds before you died
body: Done in 1.31.0: killcam_rewind.gd replays the last 3 s from the match recorder (slow motion on the kill, framed on victim + killer), skippable; the respawn waits for it (host-held online, skip = normal timer). Gate: killcam_test + net case 'killcam'.

title: Graphics upgrade: lighting, effects, terrain depth, post-processing, quality presets
body: Done in 1.31.0: gfx.gd (glows, real 2D lights on High, smoke, casings, dust, scorch), terrain_fx.gd (edge AO, rim light, grass), soldier_shadows.gd, post_fx.gdshader (grade, vignette, hit flash, bloom), Low / Medium / High setting. Gate: gfx_test.

title: Flaky: gate server query timed out its own dedicated server
body: The LAN + query case needed ~31 s against a 30 s server timeout; now 50 s.

title: [selfcheck] regression detected at 22f5bde
body: Closing: not reproducible. Dedicated servers start cleanly in every release-gate run (net cases ctf/dm/fill/ranked/friends/respawn/killcam/drive/lan/m3/m7/m9) and on the live official server (1.31.0). Nothing in the repo matches the selfcheck tool that filed this.
